## Codex runtime mapping

This workflow depends on `cursor-how`, `cursor-why` when rationale matters, and `cursor-arena` for structural alternatives. Resolve exact installed names before invocation; a published mirror is not proof of availability. Native model and effort selection follows the standing `model-capability-router`. The coordinator owns design synthesis, implementation and re-design when the sketch fails.
codex_rule: Respect native Codex model/effort, permissions and actual tool availability; no automatic Cursor runtime equivalence.
